cues: Always singular: each, every, either, neither, one, everyone, someone, anybody, nobody, nothing, many a, and more than one, even though its meaning is plural: more than one house was damaged.
Always plural: both, few, a few, many, several, others.
And some words depend on the noun after of: some, all, most, half, none, a lot, the rest, fractions and percentages.
